Paint with Algorithms

Vexy Playlines transforms ordinary pixels into expressive, infinitely scalable vector artwork. It analyzes tone, edges, and shapes in your images, then renders them with math-precise lines, dots, letters, or patterns — adding depth and razor-sharp clarity at any size.

Vexy Playlines

Playlines brings algorithmic art to your browser. Drop in an image, pick one of 14 fill modes, tweak the parameters, and see the results instantly.

Five fill modes are free for everyone, with free SVG copy and download. Sign in with FontLab Pass to unlock nine premium modes and use your account-wide Vexy Coins balance: copying or downloading SVG from a premium mode costs 1 Vexy Coin per action.
